Figures are the /demo profile on 2026-10-09; demo-data.ts dates move with the calendar, so READ THE FIGURES BACK OFF THE FRAMES YOU SHOOT and update `figures` before appstore_check.py.
_how_to_use: Drop-in for tre-forged-marketing content/appstore.json. REPLACE the shot with the same `replaces` id, then delete the `replaces` key. ADD the three new `features` entries (safe_to_spend, quick_add, car) (05-plan reuses the existing `paycheck` feature). Leave `forbidden` as is (crops start below the DEMO / Sign Up Free strip). iPad crops are first guesses: check them in appstore_check.py on the PC.
